title: LLM outage contract (run against healthy AND dead provider)
description: The single contract shared by LLM timeout, API failure, rate limiting, retry-budget exhaustion, empty completions and truncated output: HTTP 200 with a graceful reply — never a 500 and never an invented answer. Run the whole suite twice: once with a working LLM_BASE_URL, once with LLM_BASE_URL pointing at an unreachable endpoint. This step must pass both times. The provider-level breakdowns themselves are unit-tested in tests/unit/llm_factory/test_openai_compatible_fallbacks.py.

notes: Acceptance is intentionally wide: both the healthy-provider replies and the deterministic fallbacks must satisfy it.
